Íslenska Solver

One small draggable button for iPad Safari. Tap ON to automatically place the best move and click Leika; tap OFF to stop remaining actions. Starts OFF.

Save a Safari bookmark, edit its URL, and paste this complete one-line bookmarklet:

iPad setup

  1. Open an ordinary webpage in Safari.
  2. Tap Share → Add Bookmark → Save.
  3. Open Safari bookmarks and edit that bookmark.
  4. Name it Íslenska Solver.
  5. Delete its URL and paste the complete javascript: URL above.
  6. Save, return to a webpage, and tap the bookmark.

Tap again to hide; tap again to show. Pages with restrictive security policies may block bookmarklets: use another ordinary webpage. Drag the button to move it without toggling. Hiding switches automation OFF. Every fresh launch starts OFF; the dictionary cache is kept on the page origin where you launch.
